title: Parity of the Absolute Value Function h(t) = 2|t| + 1
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine whether the function h(t) = 2|t| + 1 is even, odd, or neither, and justify your answer.

steps.title: Evaluate h(-t)
steps.explanation: Substitute -t for t in the formula h(t) = 2|t| + 1.
steps.why: Testing for symmetry requires evaluating the formula at the negated input -t.

steps.title: Simplify Using |-t| = |t|
steps.explanation: Since |-t| = |t| for every real number t, the expression simplifies immediately to 2|t| + 1 = h(t).
steps.why: The absolute value function is invariant under sign negation.

steps.title: Conclude Function Parity
steps.explanation: Because h(-t) = h(t) for all t in R, h(t) = 2|t| + 1 is an even function whose V-shaped graph with vertex (0, 1) is symmetric about the vertical axis.
steps.why: Any linear combination of even functions (|t| and 1) is an even function.
